- [90.0] Must-Play

Stellar Blade: Complete Edition brings its satisfying combat and stylish action to Nintendo Switch 2 with surprisingly few gameplay compromises. While reduced visual fidelity and uncomfortable Joy-Con 2 controls hold it back, the complete package and excellent Bayonetta collaboration make this an impressive port that proves Eve's adventure is just as enjoyable on Nintendo hardware.
- [80.0] Stellar Blade remains a brilliant slasher, but this Switch 2 port requires playing through slightly gritted teeth. - [80.0] The Switch 2 version of Stellar Blade is competent but struggles to hit the same heights as the original. With its steady framerate, the game runs extremely well both docked and handheld. While it’s incredible that Shift Up has managed to get the game working on Nintendo’s latest hardware, some compromises have been made. Animations dip at a distance and the game isn’t as responsive as the original. It may not be the best version of the game, but it remains a worthwhile option for those who want to experience EVE’s adventure on the go.
- [80.0] Shift Up had already proven their competence last year with the PC version of Stellar Blade. The challenge here was more demanding, but it must be admitted that a better result would have been pure science fiction.

- [80.0] Stellar Blade Complete Edition on the Nintendo Switch 2 is a valiant first step in porting a great game onto Nintendo’s newest console. This is another excellent port of a high-fidelity modern title that other developers and publishers should look up to as they consider porting their modern titles onto the Nintendo Switch 2.

Игра: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
Отзывы (16):
- [100.0] The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is arguably one of the most legendary titles in gaming history, having been highly influential and revolutionary upon its original release. This excellent remake completely modernises the visuals while introducing numerous quality-of-life improvements, offering the perfect opportunity for older gamers to relive the masterpiece that is Ocarina of Time and for newer generations to experience first-hand how a game that is almost 30 years old can still resonate with players today.
- [100.0] The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time was a masterpiece in 1998 and twenty-seven years later, it still is. With thoughtful quality-of-life changes and some excellent design rework, it is easily the best entry point into the long-running series.
- [100.0] This version meshes best with modern tastes and looks great on today’s hardware. The core classic has aged sublimely, and where it hasn’t it has been gingerly given a respectful facelift. The magic has been preserved for a new generation. It is an effortless recommendation: a wonderful experience, a captivating history lesson, and just all-around brilliant.
- [100.0] Whether you're a returning player or a newcomer, Ocarina of Time remake is the definitive way to play Link’s legendary adventure.
- [95.0] The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time proves that truly timeless game design can remain just as enjoyable nearly 30 years later. Its enchanting world, memorable characters, clever puzzles and excellent dungeons are brought to life through beautiful visuals and an outstanding soundtrack. Unnecessary loading screens, limited voice acting and the inability to complete side quests after the ending are disappointing omissions, but they do little to diminish what is one of the most joyful gaming experiences of the year.
- [90.0] Ocarina of Time proves why it has become one of the most important gaming classics. The full-fledged remake not only gives it a beautiful new look, but above all removes a number of period compromises and sensitively adjusts the controls and some puzzles. At the same time, it does not lose the original charm or the clearly guided adventure structure. It is fascinating to watch how the first 3D Zelda learns from its younger followers without trying to be modern at all costs. Some archaic elements and a slower pace remind us of how much time has passed, but otherwise it is an exceptionally well-
- [80.0] The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake feels designed for new players first and foremost, letting new generations see what made us fall in love with it back in the day, and in that regard, it succeeds with flying colors. While some decisions and directions in this remake may keep me from reaching for it again anytime soon, Ocarina of Time is a classic tale and remains a standout among the pantheon of the Zelda titles, and this remake is a great showing of why, even with its blemishes.
- [100.0] The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is, and always was, one of the best pieces in video game history. Period.
- [100.0] The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time was one of the best games in history, and now it is once again.
- [100.0] An iconic all-time story has been reborn for a new generation, and it's the best iteration of the classic Nintendo 64 favorite we've gotten yet. The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time for Switch 2 is a must-play, whether you're a franchise fan or not, and one of the best examples of how to properly reimagine an enduring masterpiece.
- [100.0] The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is a monumental game. It's revered far and wide for its tale of loss, hope, and the future of a kingdom so beloved by our world. As for remakes, I'm happy to say that this one checks a lot of boxes with its updated mechanics, score, and gameplay. Few games have such a reputation, yet even three decades later, people still talk about it.
- [100.0] This remake of the iconic 1998 game brings an ageless masterpiece back into the spotlight. Its beautiful visuals, narrative tone and gameplay improvements elevate a title whose level design and puzzles remain as magnificent as ever, 28 years later.
- [100.0] Hour by hour, dungeon by dungeon, I fell more and more in love with this game, perhaps in part because it comes from another era. You can feel how this remake never needs to prove anything or chase trends. It simply wants to be the best version of itself. With its visuals, audio, game design, scope, complexity, and gamefeel - oh my god, the gamefeel! - all absolutely spot on, the Zelda: Ocarina of Time Switch 2 remake is something I truly never expected: a perfect game.
- [100.0] Nintendo proves that it is possible to faithfully remake one of the greatest games ever made while adding the right technical improvements to make it feel right at home today. The love and attention to detail shine through as you rediscover Hyrule accompanied by an incredible soundtrack. However, its faithfulness to the original also means that the adventure rarely manages to surprise.
- [100.0] The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is a remake for the ages, blending the charm and whimsy of the original with more digestible gameplay and stunning visuals. It's as timeless as it ever was, managing to recreate one of the most beautiful games to date without compromising the magic of its 1998 predecessor – only adding to it. Between newly voiced dialogue, revamped dungeons, fresh puzzles, and more, Hyrule has never felt so alive.
- [100.0] The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time for the Nintendo 64 is an undisputed masterpiece, with the Nintendo Switch 2 remake being the sleeker, sexier new version with a few extra tricks up its sleeve. While I’d have still liked the remake to explore some of that cut content from the Nintendo 64 era, I’m more than satisfied with this upgraded port.

Отзывы (6):
- [90.0] Admittedly, I wasn't sure I'd get into Cozy Game Restoration at first, especially as I was born after the 80s and 90s gaming scene, but after some time, I found myself slowly getting into the rhythm of this game: buying games, restoring them, selling or keeping, upgrading, etc. It's very satisfying, even if cleaning game-after-game does feel a bit repetitive after a while. This is the sort of game where you can't help getting addicted, wanting to play for a bit longer during a session. This was a pleasant surprise for me, and I would recommend it.
- [90.0] Cozy Game Restoration is the perfect nostalgic game to wind down and relax and it perfectly captures lo-fi chill vibes. Get stuck in a loop of ‘just one more game’ as you clean all the dirt, grime and your worries away.
- [85.0] Cozy Game Restoration had me hooked from when I opened my first parcel. Its cleaning system is a gorgeous and tactile experience, where the game's art and vibe is slowly revealed as you remove more grime. Sometimes the game's physics didn't quite work, and the selling/buying data didn't have much impact. However, I still highly recommend Cozy Game Restoration for those who love casual games and value the nostalgia of a retro game collection.
- [75.0] The writing does fall short. Instructions aren’t thorough, and descriptions like Gramps’ letter and gameplay explanations are sometimes worded weirdly. The story also seems uncertain about its identity, which is a shame because, done well, it could emphasise the game’s nostalgic feel. If you’re playing purely to clean cartridges, you’ll have the best time; if you want a sentimental experience, it might not meet expectations. Cozy Game Restoration has the promise of a beautifully heartwarming game; the story and instructions just need a little dusting.

Ooooh it's time to Batman this! That was very loud We're very visible I guess we made it! output: Блогер описывает напряжённый матч на карте «Ферма Пьера», подчёркивая, что успех в игре полностью зависит от контроля танковых позиций и грамотной расстановки гарнизонов. По его мнению, у немецкой команды изначально более сложная позиция, однако она может долго удерживать фланг при успешном контроле ключевого холма и использовании укрытий. Автор отмечает, что сражение за центральную точку превратилось в невероятно хаотичную «кровавую баню», где всё решали артиллерия, поддержка бронетехники и точные выстрелы из гранатомётов. В процессе комментирования он также указывает на критические ошибки игроков в координации и установке точек спавна, которые стоили командам драгоценного времени и ресурсов.

output: В канун Нового года блогеры решили провести время в Minecraft, чтобы отремонтировать свой игровой город Achievement City и привести его в порядок после разрушений прошедшего года. Игроки с юмором и ностальгией относятся к процессу: они чинят железную дорогу, восстанавливают повреждённые дома и убирают последствия старых шуток и взрывов. Команда с энтузиазмом подходит к обустройству карты, превращая опасные локации в памятные музеи и планируя новые проекты. В целом для участников эта игра — уютный и весёлый способ подвести итоги года в кругу друзей и подготовить свой виртуальный мир к будущим приключениям.

Отзывы (7):
- [90.0] For a tenner to upgrade to the Complete Edition, Echoes of Sekighara is an absolute steal and one that perfectly rounds out the Ghost of Yotei package. The new region and questlines seamlessly slot into the base game while enhancing it with some fun yet minor gameplay additions. On top of that, Most Wanted offers a dynamic new way to experience combat.
- [90.0] Echoes of Sekigahara will take you around seven to eight hours to complete, with a fair bit of optional content to dive into alongside the main story offerings. I think it’s an excellent extension of the already engaging revenge story present in Ghost of Yotei, and a great reason for fans to return to Ezo once more.
- [85.0] Quotation forthcoming.
- [83.0] This DLC could have taken a few more risks in terms of gameplay and new features, but that doesn't change the fact that Echoes of Sekigahara serves as a fitting farewell to one of the best open worlds of recent years.
- [80.0] Ghost of Yōtei: Echoes of Sekigahara is a DLC that expands Atsu's journey without altering the base game's core formula. Its storyline, new region, side activities, and the Most Wanted mode deliver compelling content for players eager to return to this world. While it doesn't reinvent the original experience, it stands as a worthwhile expansion for those craving more.
- [80.0] The free new rogue-lite mode may turn some heads, but Echoes of Sekigahara is the real star, delivering a strong narrative and a small but packed new region. It doesn't significantly build on or alter Yōtei's core gameplay, but it remains enjoyable.
- [80.0] Most Wanted, while ultimately a welcome addition, has its share of problems, but it is certainly the weaker part of the Ghost of Yotei‘s new DLC. Echoes of Sekigahara is significantly more elegant, tying the themes of redemption and guilt seen in its story into the very soil of its world. Ghost of Yotei followed in Ghost of Tsushima‘s footsteps in a lot of ways, and now the two share yet another aspect: a well-crafted expansion that has some of the best moments of the entire game.

Игра: The Wolf Among Us Remastered
Отзывы (10):
- [90.0] The Wolf Among Us Remastered is a faithful revival of Telltale’s other great series. Not interested in altering what made the original worthwhile, this is a new way to appreciate Fabletown before the long-awaited sequel finally, hopefully arrives.
- [90.0] It's been 13 years since The Wolf Among Us first released, and it's just as good as ever. Thanks to this Remastered release, it looks and plays better than it ever did, too, and a wealth of bonus content makes it a worthwhile purchase even if you've already played it to death.
- [90.0] Despite a few small issues, the new team at Telltale has renewed my faith in the franchise. The Wolf Among Us Remastered is more than just a fresh coat of paint; it’s never been a better time to step into the Big Bad Wolf’s shoes, meet people and creatures from fairytale legend, and hunt for a mysterious killer in the grimy alleys and clubs of '80s New York.
- [90.0] The Wolf Among Us Remastered lives up to its name. It’s the best way to revisit one of Telltale’s best-crafted stories, and the bonus content will make you appreciate it even more after you’ve rolled credits again. This is an easy recommendation whether you’ve played it before or are coming to the series for the first time.
- [90.0] The Wolf Among Us Remastered gives Telltale’s classic a beautiful overhaul while preserving its story and atmosphere.
- [85.0] Whether this is your first time, your second time, or your twentieth time experiencing The Wolf Among Us, you'll gladly trade hours of your videogame time to this remaster. Bigby is back in this bold and bawdy replenishment, and you definitely won't regret devouring this renewed adventure series.
- [81.0] Bigby and the cast of Fabletown deliver an intriguing story in a very unique game world that will keep you engaged through to the end. Plus, the enhanced visuals and bonus content in The Wolf Among Us Remastered are definitely welcome additions.
- [80.0] The Wolf Among Us Remastered is a wonderful example of a remaster. Not only does it improve the visuals, but it also irons out performance issues from the original release. The detective tale is every bit as engaging as you’ll remember, expertly balancing gripping storytelling, memorable characters, and meaningful choices to deliver an unforgettable experience. With the addition of behind-the-scenes content, a noir filter and deleted scenes, this is the perfect celebration of a classic.
- [80.0] The Wolf Among Us Remastered is the perfect appetizer ahead of the sequel's release. It brings the fantastic narrative to a new audience, with plenty of additional features for longtime fans to appreciate. While some of the lighting changes diminish the original's identity, and the relatively small amount of new additions are a tad disappointing, the overall quality of both The Wolf Among Us itself and its remaster are more than enough to justify the asking price.
- [80.0] The Wolf Among Us Remastered is a great return to one of Telltale‘s best titles. It might not include any new story content, but it feels complete. I’m eager to return to Fabletown with The Wolf Among Us 2, but in the meantime, the remaster is a brilliant entry point for a new generation. Aside from some lingering dated animations, the remaster of The Wolf Among Us is filled with excellent moments.

There is some replayability but even without it the game is entertaining enough for its short duration.

Игра: Terrible Lizards
Отзывы (10):
- [10.0] This game is a mix of mirrors edge with a dash of bioshock and a hint of firewatch. Its atmosphere and story telling are top notch with live action cutscenes that really bring the 90s nostalgia, the voice acting and music really set the scene and the atmosphere and tension keep you hooked. The parkour is smooth and responsive with great platforming that would make a Mario brother jealous , once I started I couldn’t put it down the story kept me gripped and the gameplay keeped me entertained ,this studios first outing is a brilliant one. Would highly recommend this awesome title to any dino lov
- [10.0] A really great experience and a pleasant surprise. 
For a debut game from an indie studio, it lives up to its promise. There are a few bugs, but that’s to be expected when a game is first released.
I really liked the design of the various creatures; the environments are varied and easy to navigate. I was worried it might be too dark despite the lamp, but in the end, that wasn’t the case at all. I just found the parkour and character physics a bit tricky at first. 
After the first hour, I didn’t even think about it anymore.
I highly recommend it; you can tell it’s been made with passion !
- [1.0] TL;DR: bugs prevent finishing the game after about 6 hours. Don't waste your time until they fix it.

I enjoyed this game until about 6 hours and 95% of the way through (I think based on the story) there are game-breaking performance issues on the Series X that make it literally unplayable. The game stutters and stops, and either freezes me or warps me backwards 2 seconds where I fall.
- [10.0] Really enjoying Terrible Lizards. It’s a fun game with a lot of personality. Definitely worth checking out if you’re looking for something different and entertaining.
- [10.0] Such a refreshing indie horror game especially for a studio's debut!  Gameplay is great, vaulting and climbing is smooth and fun.  Each level has its own unique aesthetic but it still feels cohesive.  And of course the creature design is awesome!
- [1.0] [SPOILER ALERT: This review contains spoilers.]

- [10.0] Super entertaining game. The parkour mechanics are fluid and fun. I played it on my Xbox series x and it ran smoothly with no lag issues throughout the 6 hour story. Highly recommend!
- [9.0] A surprisingly great game which was not on my radar. I was expecting a poppy playtime esque rip off but what I actually got was more akin to mirrors edge with creatures. It was very refreshing given how few parkour games seem to be released (or at least good ones). I don’t know if my scoring is skewed because it scratched an itch so satisfyingly but it’s a 9 from me.
- [8.0] Me and my son have been playing horror games together for years, particularly indie horror. This game has genuinely been a refreshing adventure. not tacky mascot horror, obvious plots or repetitive use of the same game play space. This was such a fun, original, spooky and creative adventure full of skill building and checks, new places to navigate and terrifying visuals to shake you along the way. Super fun and one we'll remember and replay again and again.

output: Блогер Jacksepticeye выражает смешанные чувства: он взволнован выходом игры, но одновременно сомневается в её качестве, особенно в отношении адаптации сюжета и выбора персонажей. Он отмечает, что Telltale слишком сильно ориентируется на фильм, а не на комиксы, и это делает игру менее оригинальной. Критически относится к отсутствию голосов оригинальных актёров (например, Крис Прэтт) и к тому, что Тони Старк и другие герои звучат неестественно. В итоге он считает, что игра не оправдала ожиданий, особенно из‑за того, что Тони Тессера (Танос) убит слишком рано и сюжет выглядит поверхностным.

Игра: Cozy Game Restoration
Отзывы (6):
- [90.0] Admittedly, I wasn't sure I'd get into Cozy Game Restoration at first, especially as I was born after the 80s and 90s gaming scene, but after some time, I found myself slowly getting into the rhythm of this game: buying games, restoring them, selling or keeping, upgrading, etc. It's very satisfying, even if cleaning game-after-game does feel a bit repetitive after a while. This is the sort of game where you can't help getting addicted, wanting to play for a bit longer during a session. This was a pleasant surprise for me, and I would recommend it.
- [90.0] Cozy Game Restoration is the perfect nostalgic game to wind down and relax and it perfectly captures lo-fi chill vibes. Get stuck in a loop of ‘just one more game’ as you clean all the dirt, grime and your worries away.
- [85.0] Cozy Game Restoration had me hooked from when I opened my first parcel. Its cleaning system is a gorgeous and tactile experience, where the game's art and vibe is slowly revealed as you remove more grime. Sometimes the game's physics didn't quite work, and the selling/buying data didn't have much impact. However, I still highly recommend Cozy Game Restoration for those who love casual games and value the nostalgia of a retro game collection.
- [75.0] The writing does fall short. Instructions aren’t thorough, and descriptions like Gramps’ letter and gameplay explanations are sometimes worded weirdly. The story also seems uncertain about its identity, which is a shame because, done well, it could emphasise the game’s nostalgic feel. If you’re playing purely to clean cartridges, you’ll have the best time; if you want a sentimental experience, it might not meet expectations. Cozy Game Restoration has the promise of a beautifully heartwarming game; the story and instructions just need a little dusting.
- [70.0] Certain parts of the cleaning process—such as removing stickers or frequently washing the equipment—can be a bit annoying; if you’re the type of person who insists on 100 percent perfection across the board, it might test your patience. On the other hand, if you enjoy things like "ASMR" and are looking for a calm, visually pleasing, and aesthetically delightful game that helps you relax, then this is definitely for you.
- [50.0] There’s no argument here that Parasol Corp has made a cosy game with clever mechanics. But, whilst it doesn’t punish you for failing, it feels like Cozy Game Restoration just missed the mark on giving you back a truly rewarding experience.

Отзывы (7):
- [90.0] For a tenner to upgrade to the Complete Edition, Echoes of Sekighara is an absolute steal and one that perfectly rounds out the Ghost of Yotei package. The new region and questlines seamlessly slot into the base game while enhancing it with some fun yet minor gameplay additions. On top of that, Most Wanted offers a dynamic new way to experience combat.
- [90.0] Echoes of Sekigahara will take you around seven to eight hours to complete, with a fair bit of optional content to dive into alongside the main story offerings. I think it’s an excellent extension of the already engaging revenge story present in Ghost of Yotei, and a great reason for fans to return to Ezo once more.
- [85.0] Quotation forthcoming.
- [83.0] This DLC could have taken a few more risks in terms of gameplay and new features, but that doesn't change the fact that Echoes of Sekigahara serves as a fitting farewell to one of the best open worlds of recent years.
- [80.0] Ghost of Yōtei: Echoes of Sekigahara is a DLC that expands Atsu's journey without altering the base game's core formula. Its storyline, new region, side activities, and the Most Wanted mode deliver compelling content for players eager to return to this world. While it doesn't reinvent the original experience, it stands as a worthwhile expansion for those craving more.
- [80.0] The free new rogue-lite mode may turn some heads, but Echoes of Sekigahara is the real star, delivering a strong narrative and a small but packed new region. It doesn't significantly build on or alter Yōtei's core gameplay, but it remains enjoyable.
- [80.0] Most Wanted, while ultimately a welcome addition, has its share of problems, but it is certainly the weaker part of the Ghost of Yotei‘s new DLC. Ghost of Yotei followed in Ghost of Tsushima‘s footsteps in a lot of ways, and now the two share yet another aspect: a well-crafted expansion that has some of the best moments of the entire game.

Игра: Ghost of Yotei: Echoes of Sekigahara
Отзывы (7):
- [90.0] For a tenner to upgrade to the Complete Edition, Echoes of Sekighara is an absolute steal and one that perfectly rounds out the Ghost of Yotei package. The new region and questlines seamlessly slot into the base game while enhancing it with some fun yet minor gameplay additions. On top of that, Most Wanted offers a dynamic new way to experience combat.
- [90.0] Echoes of Sekigahara will take you around seven to eight hours to complete, with a fair bit of optional content to dive into alongside the main story offerings. I think it’s an excellent extension of the already engaging revenge story present in Ghost of Yotei, and a great reason for fans to return to Ezo once more.
- [85.0] Quotation forthcoming.
- [83.0] This DLC could have taken a few more risks in terms of gameplay and new features, but that doesn't change the fact that Echoes of Sekigahara serves as a fitting farewell to one of the best open worlds of recent years.
- [80.0] Ghost of Yōtei: Echoes of Sekigahara is a DLC that expands Atsu's journey without altering the base game's core formula. Its storyline, new region, side activities, and the Most Wanted mode deliver compelling content for players eager to return to this world. While it doesn't reinvent the original experience, it stands as a worthwhile expansion for those craving more.
- [80.0] The free new rogue-lite mode may turn some heads, but Echoes of Sekigahara is the real star, delivering a strong narrative and a small but packed new region. It doesn't significantly build on or alter Yōtei's core gameplay, but it remains enjoyable.
- [80.0] Most Wanted, while ultimately a welcome addition, has its share of problems, but it is certainly the weaker part of the Ghost of Yotei‘s new DLC. Echoes of Sekigahara is significantly more elegant, tying the themes of redemption and guilt seen in its story into the very soil of its world. Ghost of Yotei followed in Ghost of Tsushima‘s footsteps in a lot of ways, and now the two share yet another aspect: a well-crafted expansion that has some of the best moments of the entire game.

- [90.0] Despite a few small issues, the new team at Telltale has renewed my faith in the franchise. The Wolf Among Us Remastered is more than just a fresh coat of paint; it’s never been a better time to step into the Big Bad Wolf’s shoes, meet people and creatures from fairytale legend, and hunt for a mysterious killer in the grimy alleys and clubs of '80s New York.
- [90.0] The Wolf Among Us Remastered lives up to its name. It’s the best way to revisit one of Telltale’s best-crafted stories, and the bonus content will make you appreciate it even more after you’ve rolled credits again. - [90.0] The Wolf Among Us Remastered gives Telltale’s classic a beautiful overhaul while preserving its story and atmosphere.
- [85.0] Whether this is your first time, your second time, or your twentieth time experiencing The Wolf Among Us, you'll gladly trade hours of your videogame time to this remaster. - [81.0] Bigby and the cast of Fabletown deliver an intriguing story in a very unique game world that will keep you engaged through to the end. Plus, the enhanced visuals and bonus content in The Wolf Among Us Remastered are definitely welcome additions.
- [80.0] The Wolf Among Us Remastered is a wonderful example of a remaster. Not only does it improve the visuals, but it also irons out performance issues from the original release. The detective tale is every bit as engaging as you’ll remember, expertly balancing gripping storytelling, memorable characters, and meaningful choices to deliver an unforgettable experience. With the addition of behind-the-scenes content, a noir filter and deleted scenes, this is the perfect celebration of a classic.
- [80.0] The Wolf Among Us Remastered is the perfect appetizer ahead of the sequel's release. It brings the fantastic narrative to a new audience, with plenty of additional features for longtime fans to appreciate. While some of the lighting changes diminish the original's identity, and the relatively small amount of new additions are a tad disappointing, the overall quality of both The Wolf Among Us itself and its remaster are more than enough to justify the asking price.
- [80.0] The Wolf Among Us Remastered is a great return to one of Telltale‘s best titles. It might not include any new story content, but it feels complete. I’m eager to return to Fabletown with The Wolf Among Us 2, but in the meantime, the remaster is a brilliant entry point for a new generation. Aside from some lingering dated animations, the remaster of The Wolf Among Us is filled with excellent moments.

- [100.0] Phantom Blade Zero is the best game I have played this year, and quite possibly the best Action RPG I have ever played. - [100.0] After waiting all these years for Phantom Blade Zero and playing it from front to back, it’s clear that S-GAME put real love into creating this masterpiece. - [98.0] Phantom Blade Zero is undoubtedly an exceptional, remarkable, and truly unique game. While occasional level design frustrations, some narrative shortcomings, and PC performance issues prevent it from achieving perfection, S-GAME has created an extraordinary experience that stands among the best games of 2026.

Игра: Faraway
Отзывы (5):
- [78.0] Faraway is an at-times exacting physics puzzle game in the appealing disguise of a chill-vibe experience. In truth, playing Faraway without mastering its timing and mechanics is not much fun. It’s absolutely possible to get into a flow state where the physics becomes second nature and the music and lights join in, but the trippy good time will come only after lots of practice.
- [75.0] It is striking how such a relatively minor adjustment to the elements at play can result in a significantly different gameplay experience—further evidence of a design philosophy rooted in total minimalism, which permeates the very structure of the game, extending well beyond its captivating aesthetic.
- [70.0] Faraway blends puzzle and arcade gameplay into a minimalist experience. Building constellations and uncovering the potential of its one-button controls is fun, especially when mastering more advanced techniques. However, its simple modes can become repetitive, while the controls sometimes lack the precision needed to bring the game's ideas to life. Still, it is a charming and distinctive experience, as beautiful as the shooting star at the heart of its brief, fleeting journey.
- [65.0] The universe is infinite, yet Faraway makes you feel like your hands are tied. Its simple, straightforward gameplay would have been a hit a decade or so ago, on mobile devices and handheld consoles, but today's vast indie landscape and the increasingly high standards of low-budget games demand something more. Faraway works, has style, and remains entertaining despite its inherent limitations, but there's still a lingering feeling that it could have been so much more.
- [None] Though Annapurna Interactive has a reputation for publishing interactive movies these days, it’s arguably at its best when it's using its sharp eye to scope out games like this. Faraway joins a pantheon of minimalist triumphs under the label, a class that includes the poetic Gorogoa and unforgettably strange Cocoon. It isn’t likely to get as much awards buzz as a story-forward game like Mixtape, but the soul-nourishing constellation game deserves its flowers for being every bit as expressive by barely saying a word.

- [100.0] The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time was a masterpiece in 1998 and twenty-seven years later, it still is. With thoughtful quality-of-life changes and some excellent design rework, it is easily the best entry point into the long-running series.

- [100.0] The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is, and always was, one of the best pieces in video game history. Period.
- [100.0] The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time was one of the best games in history, and now it is once again.
- [100.0] An iconic all-time story has been reborn for a new generation, and it's the best iteration of the classic Nintendo 64 favorite we've gotten yet. - [100.0] The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is a monumental game. It's revered far and wide for its tale of loss, hope, and the future of a kingdom so beloved by our world. В целом, он считает, что графика, фреймрейт и геймплей делают эту игру выдающейся в своём жанре.

Отзывы (7):
- [80.0] ANOMALITH is a solid first outing for FURYU in the Survival Horror genre. The story, world, and characters are interesting. Gunplay is satisfying even with the tank controls, and the customization is quite competent.
- [73.0] Reona’s survival story and some pulpy dialogue give ANOMALITH plenty of personality, making its distorted spaces worth exploring. The shooting and upgrades are mostly satisfying, but some instances of repetition and 'longest walking route' syndrome might test your patience.
- [70.0] ANOMALITH is the kind of game whose strongest aspects manage to shine through, despite its numerous flaws holding them back. It's got excellent gunplay, satisfying progression, and compelling character-driven story, even as its uneven systems undermine the survival horror it sets out to deliver. It's far from an excellent game, but within its score bracket, it's certainly one of the most memorable.
- [70.0] Anomalith is full of flaws, but also full of so much to appreciate. It's a gripping liminal sci-fi adventure that oozes style, and I loved exploring every otherworldly corner of it.
- [70.0] Sometimes a decent, breezy game hits just right. Anomalith didn’t blow me away or make my jaw drop, but it was fun and engaging enough to justify my time with it, stand out in my mind, and file it as a win in FuRyu’s unstable library. It’s no The Alliance Alive of course, but very little out there is. If you saw Backrooms this year and have been jonesing for more media in that space, Anomalith is a fun twist that takes things in a different direction from just being unsettled by spooky hallways with oddly-placed furniture. Although there’s plenty of that here too, you just have the powers of b
- [70.0] Anomalith stands out by focusing on arcade action and its supernatural story and ambiance, but a promising first impression is progressively hindered by conflicting design decisions.
- [50.0] Anomalith is a game that feels out of place and out of time. Some things lead to a sense of nostalgia and wonder that are really valuable in a game. Нравится: увлекательный сюжет с интересными персонажами, стильный и атмосферный мир, динамичный и удовлетворительный геймплей с оружием и кастомизацией, а также возможность исследовать причудливые локации и получать удовольствие от аркадного шутера.

- [85.0] Heir of the Dog picks up right where adventure game classics like Maniac Mansion left off in a lengthy adventure with rollicking wit. There are a few rough spots, but those are largely outshone by the delightful humor, wacky antics, and brain busing puzzles.

- [10.0] This game is a mix of mirrors edge with a dash of bioshock and a hint of firewatch. Its atmosphere and story telling are top notch with live action cutscenes that really bring the 90s nostalgia, the voice acting and music really set the scene and the atmosphere and tension keep you hooked. The parkour is smooth and responsive with great platforming that would make a Mario brother jealous , once I started I couldn’t put it down the story kept me gripped and the gameplay keeped me entertained ,this studios first outing is a brilliant one. Would highly recommend this awesome title to any dino lov
- [10.0] A really great experience and a pleasant surprise. 
For a debut game from an indie studio, it lives up to its promise. There are a few bugs, but that’s to be expected when a game is first released.
I really liked the design of the various creatures; the environments are varied and easy to navigate. I was worried it might be too dark despite the lamp, but in the end, that wasn’t the case at all. I just found the parkour and character physics a bit tricky at first. 
After the first hour, I didn’t even think about it anymore.
I highly recommend it; you can tell it’s been made with passion !
- [1.0] TL;DR: bugs prevent finishing the game after about 6 hours. Don't waste your time until they fix it.

- [10.0] Really enjoying Terrible Lizards. It’s a fun game with a lot of personality. Definitely worth checking out if you’re looking for something different and entertaining.
- [10.0] Such a refreshing indie horror game especially for a studio's debut!  Gameplay is great, vaulting and climbing is smooth and fun.  Each level has its own unique aesthetic but it still feels cohesive.  And of course the creature design is awesome!
- [1.0] [SPOILER ALERT: This review contains spoilers.]

- [10.0] Super entertaining game. The parkour mechanics are fluid and fun. I played it on my Xbox series x and it ran smoothly with no lag issues throughout the 6 hour story. Highly recommend!
- [9.0] A surprisingly great game which was not on my radar. I was expecting a poppy playtime esque rip off but what I actually got was more akin to mirrors edge with creatures. It was very refreshing given how few parkour games seem to be released (or at least good ones). I don’t know if my scoring is skewed because it scratched an itch so satisfyingly but it’s a 9 from me.
- [8.0] Me and my son have been playing horror games together for years, particularly indie horror. This game has genuinely been a refreshing adventure. not tacky mascot horror, obvious plots or repetitive use of the same game play space. This was such a fun, original, spooky and creative adventure full of skill building and checks, new places to navigate and terrifying visuals to shake you along the way. Super fun and one we'll remember and replay again and again.

- [100.0] Phantom Blade Zero is the best game I have played this year, and quite possibly the best Action RPG I have ever played.
